symptom: ako/mxcli#2033: `run --local --watch --test-endpoint --detach` logged 'Change detected, rebuilding (build #2)' right after the boot with nothing edited; mxbuild --serve was restarted for dist/pages, ~30 s of 404s on every page and a 'Failed to preserve application state during reload'. Without --test-endpoint it stayed on build #1.
cause: The boot build scaffolds themesource/<module>/ for a module that has none (here MxTest, which --test-endpoint injects); those .json/.js files are watched theme source newer than the boot baseline, so the watcher read the build's own output as an edit.
file: cmd/mxcli/docker/runlocal.go (buildScaffold, themeModuleFolders, sourceMTimeExcept; settleSource takes a source func)
insight: A watcher whose baseline is taken before the build (to keep edits made during boot) must still exclude what the build itself writes into watched folders; excluding by 'folder the build created, up to the build's end' keeps both. Reproduced end to end with a main-built binary as the control on a blank `mxcli new` app with --db-type hsqldb — no Postgres needed.
